description: This Java source file defines the class DeviceConnectionClientImpl, which implements the DeviceConnectionClient interface. It provides methods for managing device connections in the Hono platform, including setting and getting the last known gateway for a device via AMQP messaging protocol. The class includes creation methods, request handling, and response processing specific to the Device Connection API, utilizing Vert.x and Proton libraries for asynchronous communication.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DeviceConnectionClient interface for managing device connections via AMQP protocol within the Hono platform. Includes methods for creating clients, sending requests to set or retrieve the last known gateway, and handling API responses asynchronously.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Generates the AMQP target address for a given tenant ID by appending the tenant ID to the device connection endpoint constant.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new DeviceConnectionClient instance, establishing AMQP links for sending and receiving messages, with optional hooks for link closure events.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sends a request to set the last known gateway ID for a specific device, utilizing tracing spans and handling the result based on HTTP status codes.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway information for a device, processing the response through asynchronous futures and tracing spans.
